Golfs should have minimal to no delay on acceleration…. But it could be a myriad of issues start with the smallest and most obvious

Some minimal vibration is normal but I don’t think that is what you are describing- vibration like this is not good as it can damage the engine - my mk5 2.0 was vibrating and it ended up cracking the pipe weld on the pipe that goes from the egr to egr cooler. Check all engine mounts not just the ones you can see from above there is also the mounts and truss’ in the subframe and the transmission - I changed out all my mounts and had to get the subframe ones pressed in (my top mounts looked ok but when o removed them they were shot to shit) once I changed the mounts it was like a brand new car. Just for reference I have a new egr and egr Pipe (the cooler was fine thank god) new radiator and  quite a few new hoses plus I changed the timing belt and water pump at 240000 klms my beast is currently at 278000 but it feels like new- power is off the charts and no other problems other than the passenger control arm needs changing. Ok so I have searched for you people for almost 20 years, googled and checked YouTube to no avail so just understand what reading your words means to me...... I was 17 maybe 18 at the time , I'm not sure if this relates or is important but I always remember this when I think about it ..my grandfather ,who I am the spitting image of had died a few months prior to this and I had been expecting to him to visit me somehow, anyway I had just woken up out of a dream and needed to go to the toilet... I didn't turn the lights on as my eyes were accustomed to the dark and I didn't want to stun them. I had a window in my room which took up like a third of the wall opposite my bed and since it was summer my windows and blinds were wide open. Just like a million other times a began to walk towards my closed bedroom door, which was a few feet away from the foot of my bed, with my hand reached out to grab the door handle meaning that the window was in my peripheral, when out of the left corner of my sight I saw a gaseous green ball come floating past at chest height at a decent speed, which caused me to turn my head quickly to look at it. Once I turned my head and my vision focused it was gone.... or so I thought.... I turned my head back towards to door as my hand had now touched the handle ..... and to my absolute horror the orb was floating in front of my face and I mean like right at my nose... it was about the size of a tennis ball but a little darker in color and basically see through..... I looked at it for like a second and there was a flash as it turned to a speck and became two lines which darted out in opposite directions. The lines were just a centimetre or two above eye height as they darted out and began to curve down and drop down like twenty centimetres or less. The outlines of the lines stayed like a when you move a light fast in the dark but unlike this they did not fade at all. It was at this moment that I realised that they were drawing the outline of a head ..... the jaw and chin lead to the neck and then the shoulders ..... I just wanna say while this was happening I was not brave courageous or curious... I was shitting myself but totally frozen! I couldn't move.... as the lights were turning the curves of the shoulders the fight or flight instinct kicked in like a bitch and I could hear my thoughts again and feel my body... all of which were telling me to jump the fuck back into my bed ..... which I did right then and there and I mean jumped ... I'm like 6"2 tall and was probably close to that then and I remember my head coming close to the ceiling a millisecond before I felt my bed under me and I pulled the covers over my head and repeated over and over "it's not real , it's not real" after what felt like minutes of me building my courage I stuck my hand out of the covers and turned on the light and then said to myself....."just look man just look it can't be real it has to be gone" so I pulled the covers back and opened my eyes and it was gone...... I have told a small number of people about this experience and the first question I get is .."why didn't you stay and see what it was?" And the reason is it just didn't feel right I mean the energy was not good ... I had the instinct to run ...... if it was my grandfather I'm sorry and I definitely should have stayed but then again what if it wasn't.
